title: Strategy sync: sprint convergence and exec briefing for Q2 initiative trajectory
creator: Alyssa Chen
description:
Purpose: Prepare an executive-facing briefing that synthesizes sprint-level progress across Q2 initiatives (batching, KV cache improvements, Dedicated autoscaling policy, and console cost dashboards) and surfaces decision points, risks, and asks for the leadership QBR. Scope covers: recent delivery velocity, measured impact on unit economics (token cost), latency SLOs, and proposed resource asks for a 12-week allocation to accelerate rollout of kernel-scheduling improvements.

Background: After the runtime-1.18 investments last quarter we saw a 7% median token-cost improvement for chat workloads but inconsistent P95 latency for long-tail request shapes. Engineering has two parallel sprints: one focused on KV cache eviction heuristics (ENG-4201) and the other on kernel selection fallback logic (ENG-4128). Product needs to: 1) reconcile roadmap timing with Dedicated capacity sales commitments, 2) quantify marginal ROI of a 12-week targeted effort, and 3) prepare an ask for Exec that balances cost vs. SLA risk.

Key metrics to show in the briefing: P50/P95 latency by model family (gpt-like-13B, 70B), average tokens-per-request, token cost delta (baseline vs. post-optimizations), Dedicated throughput utilization, and number of customer incidents tied to latency regressions in the last 90 days.

Trade-offs considered: 
- Fast rollout of kernel changes risks regressions on niche model variants vs. delaying to expand test coverage (cost: missed sales commitments).
- Prioritizing caching improvements yields lower unit cost gains for short-turnaround chats but limited wins for long-context generative workloads.

Deliverables:
- 12-slide executive packet with one-page ask (cost and headcount), a 2-slide risk appendix, and a 1-page runbook for fallback policies.
- A data appendix (BigQuery + Grafana snapshots) with queries and dashboards linked.
- A decision log capturing the Exec decision and any follow-up workstreams.

Audience: CEO/CPO/Head of Eng/Head of Sales and partnerships.

Acceptance criteria for the briefing: clear ROI estimate (expected % cost reduction and projected latency improvements), defined success metrics for a 12-week investment, risk mitigations and rollback plan, alignment with Dedicated sales timeboxes.
